title: Summarizer input experiment
summary: Same 175k-token synthetic transcript and production thread-summary instructions. Two seeds. Gemini uses the actual production function; Sol uses the structured streaming API. Native compaction uses direct Azure only. Primary fact retention and reference-ID retention are separate checks.

manifest.judge: Exact hand-authored fixture invariants; inspect the complete summaries below.
manifest.procedure: Three summarizers, randomized order per seed. One summary call per run; same source transcript and production instructions. Include native-compaction input usage and cached/write tokens. Sol costs use common list rates; Gemini uses reported BYOK provider charge. No inference of production quality equivalence from two seeds.
